corpus.note: The corpus is READ-ONLY. Every question except I40 is pinned to head_commit; I40 is pinned to secondary_commit and is the bitemporal case.

scope.rationale: Agreed with CodeIndexer so the indexed file set and the ground-truth file set are identical. Arc carries near-complete copies of itself under .claude/worktrees; walking them would duplicate almost every symbol and collapse unique-name resolution into ambiguous-name everywhere, erasing the benchmark's signal.
scope.exclude_dir_match: directory basename, at any depth, checked before descending

ground_truth.method: Established by hand with ripgrep plus reading the source. No indexer output was consulted at any point: using the system under test as its own oracle would make the benchmark circular.
ground_truth.semantics: For target T, expect_symbols is the set of function-like symbols that hold a direct static reference to T at depth 1, restricted to the scoped file set. For a trait method declaration, an implementation of that method is a referrer (an `implements` edge) as well as any body that calls it.
excluded_from_the_answer_universe: doc comments and line comments that name the symbol
string literals that contain the symbol name
prose files (.md, .json, .html, .sh, .toml) — outside the extension list
a second extern declaration of the same C symbol
ground_truth.independent_corroboration: mistralrs-core/tests/capability_reachability.rs carries a human-maintained DEAD_SYMBOL_BASELINE cross-checked against rustc's own dead_code pass. Four of the ten zero-callers questions (I27, I30, I31, I32, I33) coincide with entries there. That list was used as a place to look, never as the answer: every line was re-verified at HEAD, and two of its comments were found to have drifted (see the note fields on I23 and I27).
